name: boss-6-t
about: The title's containment hall: a lighter build of boss-6 (the same source, rig and clips), for a boss seen at the middle distance in its stasis pod. Boss Rush: Inflation Titan, second version (2026-11-16): a headless steam-boiler titan whose 'head' is a brass valve handwheel on a short pipe, a pressure gauge in its chest with the needle in the red
bar: the game's one quality bar (2026-11-17): a figure seen at middle distance (the title's pods): 1024 px colour, 512 px other maps, about 20K triangles
